isolation_matrix_vulkan.animated tracks + noise effect (film_gra: renders correctly incl. grain (generate-family effect composites fine)
isolation_matrix_vulkan.backend auto (production default): reproduces the black-frame bug at frame 20

root_cause_hypothesis: Chronon3D Vulkan backend: an image layer whose ANIMATED track evaluates to a non-identity value (opacity != 1 or scale != 1) at a given frame renders black/empty at that frame; frames where the evaluated value is exactly identity render correctly. Static values (layer opacity field, constant-equal tracks) take a different path and render fine. The noise generate-family effect is the exception: it composites source+grain correctly even during animation. The encoder is excluded (the correct and broken renders share the same native h264 encoder). Software backend is unaffected — this is Vulkan-lane specific and reproduces with --backend auto.
repro: chronon3d_cli render --plan render_control.json --assets-root <root> --backend vulkan --encoder-backend native -o out.mp4  # frame 20 = black
chronon3d_cli render --plan iso_opacity_only.json ...  # frames 18-20 black, frame 60 correct
same plans with --backend software render correctly
note: PipelineGen/RenderingGen deliverables unaffected: identical plan JSON renders correctly on software; the discrepancy is inside Chronon3D's Vulkan compositor for animated layers.
